fields.tag: Unique identifier for the equipment or instrument
fields.equipment: The name of the industrial asset or component
fields.unit: The unit of measurement for the parameter
fields.action_remarks: Narrative description of the trigger and resulting action
fields.requirement: The mandatory rule or obligation to be followed
fields.condition: The specific state or trigger that activates a rule
fields.action: The required response or automatic result of a trigger
fields.subject: The entity or system the record pertains to
fields.confined_space_entry: Identification of equipment designated as a confined space
fields.biogas_quality_interlock: Specific trigger conditions for biogas quality
fields.digester_agitator: Identification of the digester agitator asset
fields.alarm_designation: The criticality or priority level of the alarm
fields.restriction: Prohibitions or limitations on access or activity
fields.examples: Illustrative examples of the rule or limit
fields.sensor: The specific sensor used for measurement
fields.measurement_method: The technique or hardware used to obtain a reading
fields.logging: The record-keeping requirement for an event
fields.condition_zero_drift: The trigger condition based on zero drift
fields.condition_span_drift: The trigger condition based on span drift
fields.status: The operational state of the equipment
fields.notification: The alert or reminder issued by the system
fields.frequency: How often a task or inspection must occur
fields.classification: The safety or operational category of the asset
fields.limits: The acceptable range of values for multiple parameters
fields.indicator: The visual or audible signal activated by a condition
fields.exclusion_zone: The physical boundary of a restricted area

categories.AccessRestriction: Prohibitions on entering or using an area
categories.EntryRestriction: Limitations on who or when entry is permitted
